summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through QuadratureNexus + FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, analyzing them via Ouroboros and Mycelium, and feeding synthesized patterns back to improve the system—then scale to a 24-hour autonomous autoresearch loop using teams of specialist agents.
summary.outcome: Delivered a complete EVO research pipeline (E1-E76+ experiments), deployed the Mycelium additive calibration fix (E57) with mathematical convergence proof, built a compound analytics subsystem (10+ modules), fixed 150+ test failures across FLUME/compound/universe/inference suites, and grew the test suite from ~6,797 to 7,142+ tests while running a continuous overnight autoresearch loop.

repo: autoresearch.jsonl stores experiment label at r['asi']['experiment'] (NOT top-level r['experiment']), status at r['status'] (NOT r['verdict']), and primary metric at r['metric']
Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically resets the working tree to HEAD from an orphan branch—workaround: git checkout HEAD -- <file> to restore, or use surgical git add of specific files only

SurrealDB HTTP endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:8001/sql requires probe with 'RETURN true;' (not SELECT 1), timestamps must use time::now() not string literals, and SCHEMAFULL tables block arbitrary metadata subfields—use result (option<string>) for variable data
run_llm_deliberation() overwrites _score_adjustments on every call (line 307 SET semantics)—use _mycelium_calibration for cross-cycle accumulation; this was the root cause of all E5/E6 failures
Lemonade inference on port 13307 enters silent failure state returning empty strings—probe with '2+2=' arithmetic before enabling LLM mode; all 4 voices must share one model slot to avoid OOM
autoresearch.jsonl is an LFS file tracked in git—causes pointer/content mismatch conflicts in pre-commit stash/restore; fix with 'git rm --cached autoresearch.jsonl' and add to .gitignore
KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 env var is required when committing files that trigger the Kaggle branch protection guard
Mycelium convergence formula: consensus_n = 0.85 - 0.125 * (1 - lr/2)^n—exact geometric series, asymptotically approaches HIHO threshold; validated to max_error=0.00025
FlumeVAE.forward() now returns 4 values (recon, mu, log_var, z)—legacy MLP mode via FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256); eval-mode reparameterize returns mu deterministically
BioelectricNetwork.percolation_analysis(threshold) is correct—not .percolate(); result field is largest_cluster_size not giant_component_fraction
psutil mock in compound test conftest must patch BOTH psutil.virtual_memory AND psutil.cpu_percent—patching only memory still causes guardrail blocks at 99.4% CPU on busy machines
log_result() positional signature: (run, metric, metrics, status, description, experiment)—6 required positional args before any kwargs

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback changed from SET (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment) to ADDITIVE (_mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt])—the E57 fix enabling monotonic compounding toward 0.85 threshold

_detect_oscillation(vt) checks if last 3 history entries alternate sign (a>0 != b>0 != c>0)—if oscillating, apply_mycelium_feedback uses effective_lr = learning_rate * 0.5; history capped at 5 entries

Complete rewrite from simulation to real HTTP—connect() probes 'RETURN true;' not 'SELECT 1;'; insert_flume_journey_event() packs EVO biography into result (option<string>) field as JSON to work around SCHEMAFULL blocking arbitrary metadata subfields

vault_write_sync/vault_read_sync/vault_delete_sync use loop detection: try asyncio.get_running_loop(), if no loop use asyncio.run(), if loop exists use loop.create_task()—prevents RuntimeWarning from unawaited coroutines in sync callers

Changed from self.mcp_client.vault_find_relevant_context(query, project=project) (async, called without await) to self.mcp_client.vault_search(f'...', limit=10)—using the synchronous wrapper designed for this use case

UCB1 bug: UCB1 sorts by exploration potential (untested candidates get inf score), so perfect-score candidates were excluded from beam before best_chain was updated. Fix: track actual_best = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[1]) BEFORE UCB1 sorting

Dual-mode FlumeVAE: token-mode transformer (FlumeVAE(config=FlumeVAEConfig(...))) and legacy MLP mode (FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256)); forward() always returns 4 values (recon, mu, log_var, z); reparameterize() returns mu in eval mode
Added compound_score: float = 0.0 to ExecutionResult dataclass; computed as 0.6*coherence + 0.3*success + 0.1*efficiency before returning from execute_task()

Autouse psutil fixture must mock BOTH psutil.virtual_memory (percent=50.0, total=128GiB, available=64GiB) AND psutil.cpu_percent (return_value=25.0)—missing the CPU mock caused 16 tests to fail in full suite run on a machine at 99.4% CPU

Added HIHO_THRESHOLD = 0.5 class constant; generate_next_experiments(n, session_metrics, retired_labels) uses exploit mode when avg_coherence >= 0.5, explore when below; dedup via _logged_opportunity_hashes set
OllamaEmbeddingProvider was removed from flume module—removed all @patch decorators for it; replaced flaky RNG-based mock with deterministic category vectors (deploy→dims 0-127, test→dims 128-255)
analyze_cache_effectiveness() must remain async (called with await in test_cache_warmer.py) even if it contains no real async I/O—removing async breaks one test file while fixing the other

workflow: AsyncMock required whenever mocking awaitable methods—MagicMock().method() returns MagicMock (not awaitable), causing TypeError at await; patch httpx.AsyncClient not httpx.Client
unittest.TestCase cannot use async def test_*—wrap all async client calls with asyncio.run(); create coroutines fresh each call to avoid 'coroutine already awaited' errors
FastMCP protocol requires {'type': 'text', 'text': '...'} format in content items—omitting 'type' causes silent fallthrough to wrong return branch

TDD for autoresearch: write experiment spec (hypothesis, falsification criterion) before running; experiments without retirement criteria will run thousands of times (E51: 4,786 runs with no stop condition)
Retirement criterion should use CV of last-10 keep metrics < 0.05 with n_keeps >= 20; converged AND 0%-keep experiments should both retire (different criteria needed for each case)
For surgical git commits on large repos with background processes: ruff format + ruff check --fix manually, git stash --keep-index, commit, git stash pop; avoid 'git add -A'
When FlumeVAE or similar deep-learning modules change return signatures, update unpacking in all callers—test_vae.py, evaluate_vae.py, and train_vae.py all unpacked different value counts
The HIHO balance (0.5 threshold) applied to autoresearch scheduling: exploit (tune parameters) when recent coherence >= 0.5, explore (new hypotheses) when below

Multi-agent team pattern for overnight runs: spawn specialist agents for independent subtasks (test fixes, experiments, harness), main context handles cross-cutting concerns; agents commit independently via Entire.io
Compound analytics pipeline for experiment lifecycle: experiment_analytics → experiment_scheduler → experiment_recommender → loop_visualizer provides a complete observatory for the research process
